title: Breakfast Crunchwraps
subtitle: Griddled tortilla bundles with eggs, hash, and a crunchy tostada center.
description: Griddled wraps with eggs, sausage, hash, and cheese folded tight so nothing falls out on the way to the couch. Batch-build and hold under foil.

steps.title: Gather ingredients and equipment
steps.instruction: Line up every ingredient for Breakfast Crunchwraps in the order you will cook — measure spices into ramekins, trim proteins on a dedicated board, and set tongs, thermometers, and hotel pans within arm's reach before any heat goes on. Use sour cream as listed — measure each before heat goes on.

steps.title: Preheat ovens and surfaces
steps.instruction: Preheat ovens, griddles, or grills to recipe temp before the crew arrives — cold equipment extends cook time and dries out batch Sausage. Confirm burners ignite evenly and sheet pans are greased or lined.

steps.title: Prep all fillings
steps.instruction: Crisp hash browns on a lightly oiled griddle in a thin layer, season with salt, and hold warm. Brown sausage and drain. Soft-scramble eggs last so they stay tender.

steps.title: Set the build station
steps.instruction: Lay out tortillas, tostadas, cheese sauce, and a small bowl of cheese slices cut to seal the bottom fold. Warm nacho cheese so it spreads without tearing tortillas.

steps.title: Stack and fold
steps.instruction: Center tostada on tortilla, layer hash, sausage, eggs, cheddar, and a drizzle of nacho cheese. Fold edges to center in a hex pattern; place a cheese slice on the bottom seam to glue it shut.

steps.title: Griddle both sides
steps.instruction: Cook seam-side down on a medium griddle with a light press until golden and sealed, 3–4 minutes. Flip carefully and griddle the top until crisp and cheese melts through.

steps.title: Verify safe internal temps
steps.instruction: Spot-check the thickest pieces with an instant-read thermometer — target 165°F. If any piece reads low, return it to heat immediately rather than holding under temp on the line.

steps.title: Hold for call interruptions
steps.instruction: If tones drop mid-service, cover finished food and hold at 140°F in a warm cabinet or 200°F oven — never leave proteins below 140°F for more than 30 minutes cumulative. Note the hold time on the pan with a grease pencil.

steps.title: Serve immediately
steps.instruction: Cut in half on a bias for the line or serve whole in parchment wraps. Hold finished wraps in a 200°F oven seam-side down—don't stack or you'll lose the crunch.

stationWorkflow: One cook runs the griddle press while another builds—pre-cut all seal cheese slices before the rush.
Keep tostadas in a warm dry pan so they stay shatter-crisp until the moment of assembly.
Build in batches of four; griddle while the next batch stacks so nothing sits and steams.
cleanupNotes: Scrape the griddle between batches with a bench scraper while still warm to prevent cheese carbon buildup.
Wipe the press or second skillet with a damp towel held by tongs—never submerge hot cast iron.
leftovers: Crunchwraps do not hold well; plan portions tightly and turn extras into deconstructed bowls with salsa.
If you must reheat, use a dry skillet over low heat with a lid—microwave destroys the tostada crunch.
